brief.headline: Ardian and KKR-backed investors explore €6.3bn INWIT take-private
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Ardian and a consortium of investors led by Oak Holdings 1 are working on financing arrangements for a potential take-private of Italian telecom tower operator INWIT, as the company faces contractual disputes with its two largest customers, according to a report by Reuters.
Infrastructure & Energy: HedgeCo Networks reports: KKR and TotalEnergies Added a 700 MW U.S. Solar Portfolio Valued at $1.2 Billion to Their Joint Venture.
Hedge Funds: New hedge funds are finding it increasingly difficult to raise money as institutional investors concentrate allocations among established managers.

M&A & Buyouts: KKR has prohibited non-compete agreements for employees earning less than $100,000 annually at its US portfolio companies, as the PE firm seeks to demonstrate that businesses can remain competitive without restricting workers’ future employment options, according to a report by Bloomberg.

M&A & Buyouts: DCC Energy has agreed to sell its technology division, Nexora, to private equity firm One Equity Partners for an enterprise value of $725m, as the Irish energy group prepares for its planned takeover by KKR and Energy Capital Partners, according to a report by Reuters.
brief.marketRead: The S&P 500 stands at 7,811.54 (up 0.6% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 14.8, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.22% (down 6 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.44 pts (positively sloped).
